1. Who we are

This online shop at dpcreator.co.uk is run by DPCREATOR LIMITED (“dpCREATOR”, “we”), a company registered in England and Wales, company number 17549892. Registered office: Unit 12 Quayside, Littlehampton BN17 5SF, England. Contact: info@dpcreator.co.uk or the contact form.

2. Scope

These terms apply to every order placed on dpcreator.co.uk. If you buy as a consumer, your statutory rights under UK law, including the Consumer Rights Act 2015 and the Consumer Contracts (Information, Cancellation and Additional Charges) Regulations 2013, still apply, and nothing in these terms limits them.

3. Products

  • Hardware: the dpCREATOR controller boards, the assembled SmartTabUI pendant and related parts.
  • Digital products: software licences (the SmartTabUI pendant firmware, the dpCREATOR WebUI, dpCREATOR Motion and Studio Pro), which you install from this site.
  • Free downloads: the 3D print files for the SmartTabUI case are free for everyone, with no account needed. They are not sold and are provided as is.
  • Free firmware: the dpCREATOR controller firmware is free for registered customers. It is provided as is.

Product photos and screenshots show the product as closely as we can. Small differences in colour or in the printed case can occur.

4. Prices and payment

Prices are in pounds sterling (GBP). DPCREATOR LIMITED is not registered for VAT, so no VAT is added to our prices. Delivery costs are shown at checkout before you order and are described on the Delivery and returns page. You pay with one of the payment methods shown at checkout; payments are processed by the payment provider you choose. We never see or store your full card details.

5. Placing an order

The product pages are an invitation to order. When you click the order button you make an offer to buy. The contract is made when we confirm your order by email. We may decline an order, for example if a product can't be delivered; any payment already made is then refunded in full.

Pre-order: products marked “Pre-Order” or “Coming soon” are made in batches. The expected dispatch time is shown on the product page. If it changes, we tell you by email and you may cancel for a full refund.

6. Delivery

We deliver to the addresses described on the Delivery and returns page. Digital products are available right after payment from the Flash Firmware page.

7. Your right to cancel (consumers)

If you buy as a consumer, you may cancel the contract within 14 days without giving a reason.

  • For hardware, the 14 days start on the day after you, or a person you name, receive the goods. For an order delivered in several parcels, they start when you receive the last one.
  • To cancel, tell us clearly by email or post, for example with the model cancellation form on the Delivery and returns page. Sending your notice before the 14 days end is enough.
  • Send the goods back within 14 days of your notice. You pay the direct cost of returning them.
  • We refund all payments, including the standard delivery cost, within 14 days of receiving the goods back or proof that you have sent them, using the payment method you used.
  • You are only liable for any loss in value of the goods caused by handling beyond what is needed to check their nature, characteristics and functioning. For example, a board that has been installed in a machine and wired may lose value.

8. Digital products: no cancellation once supply starts

Software licences are digital content that is not supplied on a physical medium. When you order them you ask us to start supply straight away, and you acknowledge that you lose your right to cancel once supply has started, that is, once the software can be installed or downloaded. You confirm this at checkout.

9. Licences

  • SmartTabUI pendant firmware: one licence registers one pendant by its chip ID, the first time you install the firmware on it from this site. You may then use it on that pendant and install updates from this site, from any customer account, also after the pendant changes owner. SmartTabUI is our own software and is not covered by the GPL. You may not copy, share or publish it.
  • dpCREATOR WebUI and dpCREATOR Motion: you get the right to install them from this site on up to 2 controller boards registered to your customer account and to use them with your own machines. Both are included with the dpCREATOR R3 controller and the R3 + SmartTabUI combo. A SmartTabUI pendant or pendant firmware bought before 29 October 2026 keeps the WebUI included. You may not share or publish them. They are separate programs from the controller firmware and are not covered by the GPL.
  • SmartTabUI case files: free, under the Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 4.0 licence (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0). You may print, change and share them if you credit dpCREATOR and share changes under the same licence. You may not sell the files or prints made from them without our written permission.
  • Open-source parts: the dpCREATOR controller firmware is based on FluidNC and is licensed under the GNU GPL v3. On request we provide the corresponding source code as the licence requires.

10. Faulty goods and digital content

Under the Consumer Rights Act 2015, goods must be as described, fit for purpose and of satisfactory quality, and digital content must be too. If a product is faulty, contact us first:

  • Within 30 days of delivery you can reject faulty goods for a full refund.
  • After that, we repair or replace them. If that is not possible or doesn't fix the fault, you are entitled to a refund or a price reduction.
  • You can make a claim for up to 6 years from delivery (5 years in Scotland). After the first 6 months you may need to show that the fault was there at delivery.

Damage from wrong wiring, wrong supply voltage, overload, water, mechanical damage, or changes to the hardware is not a fault.

11. Safety and liability

CNC machines, lasers and plasma cutters can cause serious injury and damage. Install the products only if you are competent to do so, follow the documentation, fit an emergency stop that cuts the machine's power, and use the correct protective equipment. The pendant E-stop cuts the step pulses on the controller, but it does not replace the machine's own safety circuits.

Nothing in these terms limits our liability for death or personal injury caused by our negligence, for fraud, or for anything else that cannot be limited by law. Otherwise we are liable for loss that is a foreseeable result of our breaking these terms. If you buy for business purposes, we are not liable for lost profit, lost production, damaged workpieces, tools or materials, or lost data.

12. Complaints and disputes

Please contact us first. We answer complaints within 14 days. If we can't resolve it together, you can get free advice from the Citizens Advice consumer helpline (citizensadvice.org.uk), or Consumer Advice Scotland in Scotland.

13. Applicable law

These terms are governed by the law of England and Wales, and the courts of England and Wales have jurisdiction. If you are a consumer living in Scotland or Northern Ireland, you may also bring proceedings there, and the mandatory consumer protection rules of the place where you live still protect you.

1. Who is responsible

The controller for your personal data on dpcreator.co.uk is DPCREATOR LIMITED, registered in England and Wales, company number 17549892, registered office Unit 12 Quayside, Littlehampton BN17 5SF, England. Contact for data protection questions: info@dpcreator.co.uk.

We process personal data under the UK General Data Protection Regulation (UK GDPR) and the Data Protection Act 2018.

2. What we collect and why

3. Who receives your data

  • Payment providers receive the data needed to take your payment. They process card data themselves under their own privacy policies.
  • Carriers receive your name, delivery address and, where needed for delivery, your phone or email.
  • Our hosting provider runs the shop's servers for us under a data processing agreement.
  • AI assistant in our shop admin: when we use it to look up an order or a support question, the details needed for that question (for example your name, order contents or message) are sent to Anthropic PBC, USA, which runs the Claude AI model for us as a processor. Anthropic does not use this data to train its models. Your data is not used for automated decisions about you.
  • Authorities and advisers such as HMRC or our accountant, where the law requires it.

We don't sell your data and don't use it for advertising profiles.

4. Cookies

The shop uses only the cookies it needs to work: a session cookie that keeps your cart and login, and cookies that remember language and currency. No tracking or advertising cookies are used, so no cookie consent is needed for these.

The page fonts are served from our own server. Opening the shop does not connect your browser to Google or any other font service.

5. WebUI update check

The dpCREATOR WebUI on your controller asks our server about once a day whether a newer build exists. It sends your board ID, your pendant ID and the build numbers over HTTPS; our server also sees the IP address of your network. It sends no cookies and nothing about your jobs or files. We use this only to answer the question and to keep the service secure; it is kept like our other server logs (see section 2). You can switch the check off with "update check" in the WebUI footer. See also Security.

6. Live demo

The SmartTabUI and WebUI demo runs entirely in your browser. What you do in it is not sent to us or to anyone else.

7. How long we keep data

  • Order and invoice data: as long as UK company and tax law requires, usually 6 years after the end of the financial year.
  • Customer account: until you ask us to delete it. Your software licences end when the account is deleted.
  • Contact messages: as long as needed to answer, then 12 months.

8. Transfers outside the UK

If a provider processes data outside the UK, we make sure the transfer is covered by UK adequacy regulations or by the UK International Data Transfer Agreement or Addendum. This applies, for example, to Anthropic in the USA.

9. Your rights

You have the right to access your data, to have it corrected or deleted, to restrict its processing, to receive it in a portable format, and to object to processing based on legitimate interests. Where you gave consent, you can withdraw it at any time. To use these rights, write to info@dpcreator.co.uk.

You may also complain to the Information Commissioner's Office (ICO), ico.org.uk, telephone 0303 123 1113.
